يحتجزون (form VIII)
# يَحْتَجِزُونَ (yaḥtajizūna) /jaħ.ta.d͡ʒi.zuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَجَزَ (iḥtajaza)
# يُحْتَجَزُونَ (yuḥtajazūna) /juħ.ta.d͡ʒa.zuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَجَزَ (iḥtajaza)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
